# `oaap fleet`

fleet keys: read-only /fleet/status access (RFC-0021).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap fleet {key} {issue,list,revoke} [label]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `object` | (one of `key`) |
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `label` | who watches, e.g. fleetview@oaap-demo |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `issue` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
| `revoke` | yes |
